coreUrl.description: cws-core REST base URL (token exchange + API)

wsUrl.description: cws-comm WebSocket base URL (ws-ticket is appended automatically)

agentToken.description: Agent api_key for CWS authentication (exchanged for JWT + ws-ticket)

agentId.description: Agent member ID on CWS (self-message filtering; auto-filled from token exchange)

agentName.description: Agent display name on CWS (used for @mention detection)

contextMessages.description: Group-context history size injected per inbound group message (default 5)

urgentQueueMode.description: How urgent System Member messages enter a busy session: steer (default, inject into the active turn) or interrupt (abort the active run)

access.description: Access control settings (semantics aligned with zylos-openmax)

dmPolicy.description: DM policy: owner (default; first DM auto-binds owner), open (anyone), or allowlist (only dmAllowFrom)

dmAllowFrom.description: Allowed DM sender member IDs (when dmPolicy=allowlist)

groupPolicy.description: Group conversation access policy (default: allowlist, keyed by groups{})

allowFrom.description: Allowed sender member IDs; empty or ["*"] = everyone; owner is exempt

mode.description: mention (default: respond only when @-mentioned), smart (receive all, model decides, [SKIP] to stay silent), or silent (per SDK access-policy)

owner.description: Bound owner (auto-bound on first DM when dmPolicy=owner)

openmax.label: OpenMax
openmax.description: OpenMax/CWS workspace channel — agent messaging over WebSocket.
